Topics · Prayer and closeness to God

How do I return to prayer when I feel unworthy?

The Quran sets no worthiness test. One who fails remembers God and asks; a beginning is one secret sentence.

If you are in pain right now, you do not have to carry it alone. Please reach out to someone you trust, or to a local crisis line or emergency number. Find a helpline near you

Part 1 of 3

﴿وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُوا۟ فَـٰحِشَةً أَوْ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَٱسْتَغْفَرُوا۟ لِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَن يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَلَمْ يُصِرُّوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And those who, when they commit an immorality or wrong themselves [by transgression], remember Allāh and seek forgiveness for their sins - and who can forgive sins except Allāh? - and [who] do not persist in what they have done while they know.

Quran · Aal Imran 3:135

Translation

Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy on him, to our God, for he will freely pardon.

Original · Hebrew

יַעֲזֹ֤ב רָשָׁע֙ דַּרְכּ֔וֹ וְאִ֥ישׁ אָ֖וֶן מַחְשְׁבֹתָ֑יו וְיָשֹׁ֤ב אֶל־יְהוָה֙ וִֽירַחֲמֵ֔הוּ וְאֶל־אֱלֹהֵ֖ינוּ כִּֽי־יַרְבֶּ֥ה לִסְלֽוֹחַ׃

Isaiah · 55:7

World English Bible

The verse describes people who, when they do wrong or wrong themselves, remember God and ask forgiveness. Then it asks a quiet question: who forgives sins but God? So the One you are ashamed before is the only one to turn to for pardon. Shame does not bar the call. The call is exactly what the verse describes at the moment of failure: remembering and asking. The verse does not say they were pure before.

A question for you

What holds you back most?

If you sayI feel I do not deserve it.
ThenThe verse describes people in your condition, and it is their remembering that it meets.
If you sayYears have passed and I do not know how to begin.
ThenThe next two steps answer exactly this.
If you sayI am ashamed before God.
ThenThe text can bear that shame. The next verse says it is God who accepts turning back.

Part 2 of 3

﴿وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى يَقْبَلُ ٱلتَّوْبَةَ عَنْ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَعْفُوا۟ عَنِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And it is He who accepts repentance from His servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do.

Quran · Ash-Shura 42:25

Translation

Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

Original · Ancient Greek

χωρὶς δὲ πίστεως ἀδύνατον εὐαρεστῆσαι, πιστεῦσαι γὰρ δεῖ τὸν προσερχόμενον τῷ θεῷ ὅτι ἔστιν καὶ τοῖς ἐκζητοῦσιν αὐτὸν μισθαποδότης γίνεται.

Hebrews · 11:6

World English Bible

The verse says God is the One who accepts turning back from His servants, pardons evil deeds, and knows what you do. 'Accepts' is in the present tense: it goes on happening. Then 'pardons', then 'knows'. He knows what you did, and accepts, and pardons, together. There is no need to hide anything or dress yourself up. Knowing in detail does not prevent acceptance.

A question for you

What does it say to you that God both accepts and knows?

If you sayThat I do not need to hide.
ThenThat is what the verse opens: no hiding and no dressing up.
If you sayThat acceptance is possible.
ThenIt is possible in the verse, and not conditioned on what came before.
If you sayI do not believe it yet.
ThenThat is fine. It is enough to read it and let the page stand.

Part 3 of 3

﴿ٱدْعُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ تَضَرُّعًا وَخُفْيَةً ۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُعْتَدِينَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

Call upon your Lord in humility and privately; indeed, He does not like transgressors.[379]

Translator's notes

[379] In supplication or otherwise.

Quran · Al-A'raf 7:55

Translation

“Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you. For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

Original · Ancient Greek

Αἰτεῖτε, καὶ δοθήσεται ὑμῖν· ζητεῖτε, καὶ εὑρήσετε· κρούετε, καὶ ἀνοιγήσεται ὑμῖν. πᾶς γὰρ ὁ αἰτῶν λαμβάνει καὶ ὁ ζητῶν εὑρίσκει καὶ τῷ κρούοντι ἀνοιγήσεται.

the Gospel (Matthew) · 7:7-8

World English Bible

﴿وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِى عَنِّى فَإِنِّى قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ ۖ فَلْيَسْتَجِيبُوا۟ لِى وَلْيُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِى لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْشُدُونَ﴾

Translation of the meaning

And when My servants ask you, [O Muḥammad], concerning Me - indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me. So let them respond to Me [by obedience] and believe in Me that they may be [rightly] guided.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:186

Translation

Yahweh is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

Original · Hebrew

קָר֣וֹב יְ֭הוָה לְכָל־קֹרְאָ֑יו לְכֹ֤ל אֲשֶׁ֖ר יִקְרָאֻ֣הוּ בֶאֱמֶֽת׃

the Psalms · 145:18

World English Bible

The verse says: call on your Lord humbly and in secret. So no one need know you have begun. The other verse says He is near and answers the call of the one who calls. It asks for no place, no clothes, no language, no count. You can begin tonight with one sentence, in your bed, in your own language.

A question for you

What will your opening sentence be?

If you sayMy Lord, I am here.
ThenThat is a whole sentence. The text asks no more than that to begin.
If you sayMy Lord, help me.
ThenSo is that. Asking for help is allowed without preamble.
If you sayI do not know what to say.
ThenHonest silence may be enough. There is a page about when God feels far.

The same in the other books

Translation

‘Call to me, and I will answer you, and will show you great and difficult things, which you don’t know.’

Original · Hebrew

קְרָ֥א אֵלַ֖י וְאֶעֱנֶ֑ךָּ וְאַגִּ֧ידָה לְּךָ֛ גְּדֹל֥וֹת וּבְצֻר֖וֹת לֹ֥א יְדַעְתָּֽם׃

Jeremiah · 33:3

World English Bible

Translation

Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

Original · Hebrew

וּ֭קְרָאֵנִי בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה אֲ֝חַלֶּצְךָ֗ וּֽתְכַבְּדֵֽנִי׃

the Psalms · 50:15

World English Bible

Translation

“I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you. For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

Original · Ancient Greek

Κἀγὼ ὑμῖν λέγω, αἰτεῖτε, καὶ δοθήσεται ὑμῖν· ζητεῖτε, καὶ εὑρήσετε· κρούετε, καὶ ἀνοιγήσεται ὑμῖν· πᾶς γὰρ ὁ αἰτῶν λαμβάνει, καὶ ὁ ζητῶν εὑρίσκει, καὶ τῷ κρούοντι ἀνοιγήσεται.

the Gospel (Luke) · 11:9-10

World English Bible

But from there you shall seek Yahweh your God, and you will find him when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.

וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּ֥ם מִשָּׁ֛ם אֶת־יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ וּמָצָ֑אתָ כִּ֣י תִדְרְשֶׁ֔נּוּ בְּכָל־לְבָבְךָ֖ וּבְכָל־נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
